title: Tofu scramble with avo, no toast
steps: Drain the tofu and pat it dry. Chop the tomato.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat and crumble the tofu in with your fingers, in pieces about the size of scrambled egg.
Add a pinch of turmeric, salt and pepper and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring, until hot and lightly golden.
Stir in the spinach and tomato for 1 to 2 minutes, until the spinach wilts.
Serve with the avo sliced on the side.
